lesson: A rigorous enclosure of the Gaussian-convolved xi at heights 1e3 to 1e11 runs in seconds to minutes once the kernel integral is a trapezoid sum with shared zeta samples on a line Re s > 1 and the tail bound keeps the gamma factor's decay e^{-pi t/8}. Adaptive ball quadrature with a constant bound for xi did not finish one evaluation. Mean-value segment enclosures removed the cost of cancellation in the sum.
